title: Payroll Input Cutoff - Belgium (v3)
content: Payroll input for Belgian clients must be received no later than the 5th working day of the month. Enterprise clients (500+ employees) with a signed SLA addendum may submit until the 7th working day. This version replaces v2 (2023).

title: Payroll Input Cutoff - Belgium (v2)
content: Payroll input for Belgian clients must be received no later than the 8th working day of the month. No exceptions apply.

title: Payroll Input Cutoff - Netherlands
content: Payroll input for Dutch clients must be received no later than the 3rd working day of the month.

title: Holiday Pay Policy - Belgium
content: Belgian employees are entitled to double holiday pay, calculated at 92% of gross monthly salary. Payment is due in June for white-collar workers and by the holiday fund for blue-collar workers.

title: Meal Voucher Regulations - Belgium
content: Maximum employer contribution per meal voucher is EUR 6.91. Employee minimum contribution is EUR 1.09. Vouchers are granted per effective working day. Part-time employees receive proportional entitlements.

title: Company Car FAQ
content: The benefit in kind for company cars is calculated using the catalogue value, CO2 emissions and age of the vehicle. The minimum BIK is EUR 1,600/year. Fuel cards are taxed separately.

title: Guaranteed Salary During Illness - Belgium
content: White-collar employees receive guaranteed salary for 30 calendar days of illness. A medical certificate must be submitted within 2 working days. After guaranteed salary, the mutual fund takes over.

title: Onboarding payroll checklist
content: For new hires: collect DIMONA declaration, bank account, tax withholding form, meal voucher preference and mobility budget choice before the 1st working day. Payroll registration must be completed by the 3rd working day of the start month.

title: Mobility Budget - Belgium
content: Employees eligible for a company car may opt for the mobility budget (three pillars). Pillar 1: eco-friendly company car. Pillar 2: sustainable transport (public transport, bicycle, housing near work). Pillar 3: cash (heavily taxed). The budget equals the total cost of ownership of the reference car.

title: Sick Leave Policy - Netherlands
content: Dutch employers must continue paying at least 70% of salary during the first two years of illness. In the first year, the minimum is the statutory minimum wage. A company doctor (bedrijfsarts) must be consulted within 6 weeks.

title: Payslip code reference
content: Common payslip codes: 1000 = base salary, 1200 = overtime, 2000 = meal vouchers, 2100 = eco-cheques, 3000 = company car BIK, 4000 = holiday pay (single), 4100 = holiday pay (double), 5000 = net expense allowance.
